hero.title: Who We Are
hero.description: A future where every child from low-income families in Ukraine has equal access to life-changing opportunities through IT education, emotional resilience, and creative development.

history.title: From a bold vision to real action
history.quote: In 2022, amidst the challenges and hardships facing Ukraine, an initiative was born – Star for Life Ukraine.
history.p1: What began as a vision quickly evolved into action, and by early 2023, we transformed into a fully-fledged charitable foundation. Our roots trace back to the global 'Star for Life' brand, founded in 2005 to empower children worldwide. With a presence across different continents, the initiative has positively impacted the lives of over 500,000 children.
history.p2: Our journey in Ukraine began with an urgent need to support young people affected by ongoing challenges in the region. With over 5 million children in need of support, our mission was clear: to provide them with the tools, education, and opportunities they deserve.

what_we_do.title: What We Do
what_we_do.description: Thousands of children from low-income families in Ukraine lack access to quality education. 'Star for Life Ukraine' is working to change this, ensuring every child has a safe environment for development.

educational.title: Educational
educational.description: Expanding knowledge and skills for the next generation.

mental.title: Mental
mental.description: Fostering resilience, confidence, and psychological well-being.

humanitarian.title: Humanitarian
humanitarian.description: Supporting the children of Ukraine in the most difficult times and providing protection.
